exportHint.xlsx: Sheets: WBS · Tasks · Milestones · Time Logs
exportHint.csv: Full WBS table, opens in Excel / Sheets

app.teamEdit: Click to edit the team name

nav.reorder: Drag to reorder (the first item is the home page)

wbs.pin: Pin column (move next to Name and keep it visible)
wbs.resizeHint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

lt.edit: Set Actual Leadtime manually — type hours, or add d for days
lt.editPlan: Set Leadtime manually — type hours, or add d for days (e.g. 1.5d)
lt.resetPlan: Back to the value from the plan

board.notOnDay: Only tasks not on this day yet

gantt.dragHint: Drag a bar to move it, drag its edges to change dates
gantt.projectHint: Click to edit this project's milestones
gantt.milestoneHint: ◆ {{name}} · {{date}} — drag left/right to move, click to edit
gantt.extendHint: Scroll to either edge to extend the timeline
gantt.zoomHint: Click an empty slot or a header cell to zoom in (Year → Quarter → Week → Day)
gantt.createHint: Day view: click an empty slot in a row to create a task on that day
gantt.created: Task created for {{date}} — type its name

list.sortHint: Click to sort: ascending ▲ / descending ▼ / none

eis.urgentDays: No Leadtime: urgent when ≤ days left
eis.sortHint: Sorted by: urgent inserts → Rank → nearest Plan End
eis.urgentHint: Auto: urgent when remaining work + {{pct}}% buffer ≥ time left to Plan End

running.title: Working on
running.idle: No timer yet — press ▶ / Start on a task

today.sub: Pick the important things first, then take them one at a time
today.highlightSub: If you only got 3 things done today, which would they be?
today.emptyList: Nothing planned yet — use "Pick tasks" to add some
today.quote: You don't have to do everything — just give time to what matters
today.strategy: Strategy is choosing what NOT to do
today.emptyColumn: Nothing for this day yet — drag from "All" or pick tasks

deps.title: Waits for
deps.hint: This task can start once these are done
deps.add: + Add a task that must finish first
deps.ganttConflict: Red dashed line = a task planned to start before the task it waits for ends — consider shifting the plan
deps.cycle: Can't pick this — it would loop back to this task
deps.dragLink: Drag onto another task → it will wait for this one
deps.ganttHint: Hover a bar and drag the ● at its end onto another task to link them (A → B = B waits for A) · click a line to remove it

tip.buffer50: 💡 Always plan ~50% extra — work usually takes longer than expected

focus.title: {{n}} open tasks — focus!
focus.body: Don't juggle too many at once; finish one thing at a time (aim for {{limit}} or fewer).

wip.title: {{n}} tasks In Progress — too much left open!
wip.body: Finish what's in progress before starting something new (aim for {{limit}} or fewer).

master.addPlaceholder: Milestone name, e.g. Design freeze, Go-live…
master.ganttHint: 💡 In the Gantt Chart, drag a ◆ left/right to move a milestone

routine.notifyDenied: Browser notifications are blocked — reminders show as in-app cards instead
routine.keepOpen: Reminders work while the app is open in a browser tab

complete.hideFilter: Hide completed (incl. tasks in completed projects/groups)

header.matrix: Prioritise today by importance and urgency
header.status: Track this week's work by status
header.master: Every project and milestone at a glance
header.gantt: Timeline of the plan and task dependencies
header.list: Every task in one table — filter and sort

onboard.title: Welcome — how do you want to start?
onboard.sub: Start for real right away, or explore with sample data first
onboard.emptyHint: Begin with an empty planner and create your own projects
onboard.demoHint: Example projects, tasks and milestones — remove them any time
onboard.privacy: Everything is stored only in this browser — nothing is sent anywhere. Back up with Export → Backup (.json).
onboard.banner: Sample data is loaded — remove it when you're ready to use the planner for real (your own items stay)
onboard.removeConfirm: Remove all sample data? Items you created yourself will stay.
onboard.resetConfirm:
Delete all projects, tasks, milestones and Today data and start over?
(Settings, theme, team name and columns stay.)

Export a backup (.json) first — this can't be undone.
onboard.teamHint: pick the OneDrive / Box folder your team shares

backup.since: No backup for {{n}} days — your data lives only in this browser and is lost if the browser data is cleared
backup.never: Never backed up ({{n}} days in use) — your data lives only in this browser and is lost if the browser data is cleared
backup.persistedHint: The browser won't evict this app's data when disk space runs low (clearing browser data still removes it)
backup.notPersistedHint: The browser hasn't granted persistent storage — data could be evicted when disk space runs low. Back up regularly (browsers usually grant it to sites you use often or bookmark/install).

team.doneEditing: ✅ {{name}} finished editing "{{task}}" — showing the latest values
team.join: Team mode: share via OneDrive / Box
team.needsPermission: Allow access to reconnect the team folder "{{folder}}" (you can keep working; changes sync afterwards)
team.syncHint: Read everyone's latest files from the team folder and save yours (also automatic every minute and when you come back to this tab)
team.syncError: Sync failed — hover for details; retrying automatically
team.leaveConfirm:
Leave team mode?
The latest data stays on this computer (single-user), and the files in the team folder are not deleted.
team.connectIntro: Everyone picks the same OneDrive / Box folder synced to their computer. Each person's changes go to their own file in that folder, and the app merges them so everyone sees the same plan. If two people change the same field, you'll be asked which value to keep.
team.unsupported: This browser can't access folders yet — use Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome on a computer
team.chooseFolderHint: e.g. OneDrive - Company › Team › ProjectPlanning (everyone must pick the same shared folder), then click "Allow" when the browser asks — choose "Allow on every visit" if offered.
team.existing: This folder already has team data (members: {{names}})
team.modeTeam: Use the team's data (data on this computer is replaced — a .json backup is downloaded first)
team.modeMerge: Also add the data on this computer to the team
team.first: The folder is empty — you're the first. The data on this computer becomes the team's starting data.
team.demoWarn: Sample data is loaded and will be shared too — remove it before connecting if you don't want that.
team.conflictsIntro: Two people changed the same field before seeing each other's change. Pick the value to keep — everyone gets the same result after syncing. Until then the newest value is shown, and every value stays in the history.
team.butEdited: but it was changed by someone who hadn't seen the delete:
team.trashIntro: Tasks, groups, projects and milestones deleted in the team (kept indefinitely). Restore brings an item back together with what was deleted with it.
team.useThisHint: Use this value again (saved as a new edit)
team.badgeConflict: Conflicting edits — open the task to choose

pwa.updateReady: A new version of the app is ready
pwa.installHint: Opens in its own window without the address bar, with an icon in the Start menu / taskbar, and works offline (same data as in the browser)
